Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), leukocyturia, nitrites, and proteinuria. Presence of hematuria and elevated urine glucose may warrant further evaluation for possible underlying diabetes or renal involvement. Low specific gravity could suggest dilute urine. Clinical correlation and prompt treatment are recommended.
